before: extends creates a subclass. A subclass can override an inherited non-final method with a compatible signature. final would prohibit overriding that method or extending a final class.

A function parameter declared as the parent type can receive a child object. Calling its overridden method uses the child implementation. Type declarations still constrain parameters and return values; overriding is not permission to break those contracts.
Expected output or behavior: welcome. Compiler evidence is recorded separately from app reading completion.
